outroLine: How many did you get? Comment your score below, and subscribe with the bell on for a new quiz every day!

lines.q: Fifty animal questions, from easy to legend, and they get harder every round. Keep score! First one: what is the fastest land animal?
lines.a: The cheetah! It can sprint at around a hundred kilometres an hour.

lines.q: What is a baby kangaroo called?
lines.a: A joey! It's about the size of a jellybean when it's born.

lines.q: What is the largest bird alive today?
lines.a: The ostrich! It can't fly, but it can outrun most horses.

lines.q: What do giant pandas mostly eat?
lines.a: Bamboo! Up to twelve hours a day of chewing.

lines.q: What do we call a male chicken?
lines.a: A rooster! A drake is a male duck, and a gander a male goose. Easy start, right?

lines.q: Which big cat has a mane?
lines.a: The lion! Only the males, though.

lines.q: What does a caterpillar turn into?
lines.a: A butterfly, or a moth! It all happens inside a chrysalis or cocoon.

lines.q: Which animal is famous for building dams?
lines.a: The beaver! Its front teeth never stop growing.

lines.q: Where do polar bears live in the wild?
lines.a: The Arctic! Penguins live down south, so they never meet in the wild.

lines.q: How many legs does a crab have, if you count the claws?
lines.a: Ten! Crabs belong to a group called decapods, which means ten feet. Ten easy ones done. How many so far?

lines.q: Round two, a bit harder. What is a group of lions called?
lines.a: A pride! Most of the hunting is done by the lionesses.

lines.q: Which animal can sleep up to twenty hours a day?
lines.a: The koala! Eucalyptus leaves give it very little energy.

lines.q: How many humps does a dromedary camel have?
lines.a: Just one! The Bactrian camel is the one with two.

lines.q: What is the largest shark in the world?
lines.a: The whale shark! And it eats mostly tiny plankton.

lines.q: What is a female deer called?
lines.a: A doe! A mare is a female horse, and a ewe a female sheep. Did you get that one?

lines.q: What colour is a zebra's skin, under the stripes?
lines.a: Black! The stripes are in the fur, not the skin.

lines.q: How many teeth does an adult dog have?
lines.a: Forty-two! That's ten more than an adult human.

lines.q: Which animal is our closest living relative?
lines.a: The chimpanzee, together with the bonobo! We share most of our DNA.

lines.q: What is a baby swan called?
lines.a: A cygnet! A gosling is a baby goose.

lines.q: Which continent has no native snakes at all?
lines.a: Antarctica! Australia, on the other hand, has plenty. Twenty done!

lines.q: Now it gets harder. Which animal has the strongest bite ever measured?
lines.a: The saltwater crocodile! Its bite is stronger than a lion's many times over.

lines.q: How many stomach chambers does a cow have?
lines.a: Four! Food goes through some of them more than once.

lines.q: Which bird has the widest wingspan?
lines.a: The wandering albatross! Over three metres from tip to tip.

lines.q: What is the fastest bird when it dives?
lines.a: The peregrine falcon! Over three hundred kilometres an hour. Fastest animal on the planet.

lines.q: How many eyes does a honey bee have?
lines.a: Five! Two big ones, and three tiny ones on top of its head. If you're enjoying this, subscribe and turn on the bell!

lines.q: Which animal has the densest fur of any animal?
lines.a: The sea otter! Up to a million hairs on one square inch.

lines.q: What do camels store in their humps?
lines.a: Fat, not water! The fat gives them energy when food is scarce.

lines.q: Which of these animals is a marsupial?
lines.a: The wombat! Its pouch even opens backwards, so no dirt gets in.

lines.q: Which mammal can live the longest?
lines.a: The bowhead whale! Some have lived for more than two hundred years.

lines.q: Which animal has the largest brain on Earth?
lines.a: The sperm whale! About four times heavier than a human brain. Thirty down, twenty to go!

lines.q: Welcome to the very hard round. Which animal has the highest blood pressure?
lines.a: The giraffe! It needs it to pump blood all the way up that neck.

lines.q: What is a baby echidna called?
lines.a: A puggle! Best baby name in the animal kingdom.

lines.q: Which is the only mammal covered in scales?
lines.a: The pangolin! It rolls into a ball when it's scared.

lines.q: Which animal can sleep with half of its brain awake?
lines.a: The dolphin! One half rests while the other keeps watch.

lines.q: What is the largest living lizard?
lines.a: The Komodo dragon! It can grow to around three metres.

lines.q: Which penguin lives near the equator?
lines.a: The Galápagos penguin! Not every penguin needs ice. That one surprises a lot of people.

lines.q: What is the largest rodent in the world?
lines.a: The capybara! It can weigh as much as an adult human.

lines.q: What is a female fox called?
lines.a: A vixen! A male fox is called a dog, or a tod.

lines.q: How many chambers does a crocodile's heart have?
lines.a: Four, just like ours! Most other reptiles have three.

lines.q: How many arms do most starfish have?
lines.a: Five! And they can grow a lost arm back. Forty done, now the legend round!

lines.q: Welcome to the legend round! Which sea creature can turn itself back into a baby?
lines.a: The immortal jellyfish! When it's hurt or old, it can restart its own life cycle.

lines.q: Which animal's blue blood is used to test medicines for safety?
lines.a: The horseshoe crab! Its blood reacts to harmful bacteria.

lines.q: What is the smallest bird in the world?
lines.a: The bee hummingbird! It weighs less than a coin.

lines.q: Which animal has the longest migration on Earth?
lines.a: The Arctic tern! From the Arctic to the Antarctic, and back, every year.

lines.q: Which animal with a backbone lives the longest?
lines.a: The Greenland shark! Scientists think some are around four hundred years old.

lines.q: What is a group of ferrets called?
lines.a: A business! Yes, really.

lines.q: Which animal makes cube-shaped poop?
lines.a: The wombat again! The cubes don't roll away, so they work as markers.

lines.q: What colour is a chow chow's tongue?
lines.a: Blue-black! A chow chow puppy is born with a pink one. Three left, stay with me!

lines.q: How many bones are in a giraffe's neck?
lines.a: Seven! The same number as in yours. Each one is just much longer.

lines.q: Last one. Which tiny animal survived being exposed to outer space?
lines.a: The tardigrade, or water bear! In two thousand seven, some survived open space on a satellite.
